answer: Make new agents earn trust slowly, like grafting an orchard: a fresh identity gets graded on many unrelated questions before its votes or attestations count, and its weight grows only with a track record. A sybil farm spinning up a juniper thicket of clones then pays real time and work per clone, while sinkholes in its history, like water vanishing into karst, show up as answers that cluster too tightly across accounts and get discounted.
